diagnostic.name: Row-completeness reconciliation
diagnostic.what_it_computes: Are facility-period rows present between each facility's first and last observed reporting periods?
diagnostic.metric: continuity coverage = received required facility-period pairs / required pairs within observed spans
diagnostic.threshold_rule_default: continuity coverage below 95% flags a gap; segment analysis is optional

methodology: Assess whether rows can be assigned to facility-period keys, whether the observed panel calendar is continuous, whether required rows are present by period and facility, whether facility-period pairs are unique, and, when a segment is bound, whether segment-period cells are complete. Expected periods are only those between the observed first and last periods for the applicable population. Verdict calculation is deterministic; KB content never supplies executable code.

configuration.continuity_floor_help: The minimum share of required facility-period rows that must be present. The same floor applies wherever a coverage-based rule is evaluated.

rules.title: Facility-period key assignability
rules.user_help: Checks that every row can be assigned to both a facility and a valid reporting period.
rules.next_step: Correct or quarantine rows with a missing facility identifier or invalid reporting period.

rules.title: Panel calendar continuity
rules.user_help: Checks that no complete reporting period is absent between the first and last periods observed in the table.
rules.next_step: Confirm whether every completely absent period is a source-delivery gap or a valid reporting exception.

rules.title: Period-level row coverage
rules.user_help: Checks whether each observed reporting period contains the required share of facility rows.
rules.next_step: Investigate reporting periods below the configured row-coverage floor.

rules.title: Duplicate facility-period pairs
rules.user_help: Finds facility-period keys that occur more than once and distinguishes exact from conflicting records.
rules.next_step: Resolve duplicate keys, prioritising pairs whose non-key values conflict.

rules.title: Facility-period row coverage
rules.user_help: Checks for missing periods inside each facility's own first-to-last observed reporting span.
rules.next_step: Investigate facilities whose rows fall below the configured coverage floor within their observed lifespan.

rules.title: Segment-period row coverage
rules.user_help: When a segment column is selected, checks required facility rows within each stable segment and reporting period.
rules.next_step: Investigate segment-period cells below the configured coverage floor; bind a segment only when it is meaningful and stable.
